---
title: "Join a Zoom meeting"
subtitle: "Use the meeting link shared with you"
description: "Join a meeting using the private Zoom invitation Elias Mohellebi shared with you, or request a meeting by email."
body-classes: contact-page
format:
  html:
    css:
      - /styles-20260924.css
      - ../contact.css
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">
resources:
  - zoom.js
---

```{=html}
<div class="contact-connect contact-zoom">
  <section class="contact-intro" aria-labelledby="zoom-intro-title">
    <p class="contact-eyebrow">Already invited?</p>
    <h2 id="zoom-intro-title">Have your Zoom link ready.</h2>
    <p>Please enter the Zoom meeting link I gave you in class or shared with you privately. Meeting links are not published on this website.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="contact-channel" aria-label="Open your Zoom invitation">
    <span class="contact-icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-camera-video"></i></span>
    <form id="zoom-join-form" class="contact-zoom-form" autocomplete="off" novalidate hidden>
      <label for="zoom-meeting-link">Your Zoom meeting link</label>
      <input id="zoom-meeting-link" type="url" inputmode="url" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false" maxlength="4096" placeholder="Paste the full https:// Zoom link" aria-describedby="zoom-link-hint zoom-link-error" required>
      <p class="contact-hint" id="zoom-link-hint">Paste the complete meeting link, including any passcode already included in it.</p>
      <p class="contact-zoom-error" id="zoom-link-error" role="alert" aria-atomic="true"></p>
      <div class="contact-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit"><i class="bi bi-camera-video" aria-hidden="true"></i> Continue to Zoom</button>
      </div>
      <p class="contact-hint">This website does not save or publish your link. Continuing opens your invitation on Zoom; access depends on the meeting's settings.</p>
    </form>
    <noscript><p>JavaScript is off. Open the Zoom invitation you received directly in your browser, or <a href="https://zoom.us/join" rel="noreferrer">join on Zoom using your meeting ID</a>.</p></noscript>
    <div class="contact-zoom-help">
      <p><strong>No link yet?</strong> Ask me in class, or <a href="../#request-meeting">request a meeting by email</a>. Please message me before calling.</p>
      <p class="contact-hint">Have a meeting ID instead? <a href="https://zoom.us/join" rel="noreferrer">Enter it on Zoom</a>.</p>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>
<script src="zoom.js" defer></script>
```
